description: Nawari Dynamic Network Topology, Layer 2 Switching, Layer 3 Routing, and Service Dependencies for Kenya Airways

panels.description: Interactive Layer 2 and Layer 3 topological graph displaying confirmed switches, routers, SBCs, endpoints, and links with real-time operational status and bandwidth. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

targets.rawSql: SELECT device_id AS id, canonical_name AS title, vendor || ' ' || COALESCE(model, '') AS "subTitle", CASE WHEN confidence_score >= 0.95 THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'INFERRED' END AS "mainStat", site_id AS "secondaryStat", CASE WHEN confidence_score >= 0.95 THEN 'green' ELSE 'orange' END AS color FROM topology_devices;

SELECT l.link_id AS id, src_if.device_id AS source, dst_if.device_id AS target, COALESCE(src_if.speed_bps, 1000000000) AS "mainStat", l.discovery_protocol AS "secondaryStat", CASE WHEN l.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'green' ELSE 'red' END AS color FROM topology_layer2_links l JOIN topology_interfaces src_if ON src_if.interface_id = l.source_interface_id JOIN topology_interfaces dst_if ON dst_if.interface_id = l.target_interface_id;

panels.description: Chronological audit log of physical link transitions, neighbor additions/losses, and route modifications detected by the topology engine. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp, change_type, target_entity_type, target_entity_id, detected_by FROM topology_changes ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50;
